views.name: v_sinh_vien_an_toan
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    ma_sv,
    ho_ten,
    lop_id,
    khoa,
    user_id,
    vector_version,
    vector_updated_at,
    create_at,
    sinh_vien_co_vector(id) AS co_vector_khuon_mat
   FROM sinhvien;

views.name: v_yeu_cau_khuon_mat_an_toan
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    sinh_vien_id,
    vector_version,
    so_anh,
    confidence_trung_binh,
    anh_xem_truoc_base64,
    ghi_chu_sinh_vien,
    trang_thai,
    nguoi_duyet,
    ly_do_duyet,
    tao_luc,
    duyet_luc,
    yeu_cau_co_vector(id) AS co_vector_tam
   FROM yeucaudangkykhuonmat;

policies.qual:

   FROM cahoc c
  WHERE ((c.id = dotdiemdanh.ca_hoc_id) AND giang_vien_co_lop(c.lop_id))))
